find_minimum_xor_pair: find the minimum XOR value pair from an array of integers
run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute the minimum XOR value from adjacent sorted array elements
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets to verify minimum XOR pair results
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to avoid mutating the input array by using a sorted copy
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which sorts an array and finds the minimum XOR of adjacent pairs
